title: Stacking Strategy (Michelle Grogan)
style: funk-rnb-reggaeton-cumbia-dnb fusion 134bpm slap bass Rhodes sax horns dembow marimba guiro congas dnb chorus beatbox claps English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Intro]
Keep your forehands center
Keep your strong side middle
Stack on serve receive
Stack to win the rally

[Verse 1]
Lefty righty stack the team
Forehands meet in the middle stream
Server stands inside the line
Partner stands the same side fine
Vamos vamos team align
Uno dos tres formation sign
After contact slide back home
Ready stance then no roam

[Pre-Chorus]
Stack and switch
Stack and stay
Stack and switch
Win the day

[Chorus]
Stacking strategy stacking strategy
Forehands center forehands free
Stacking strategy stacking strategy
Vamos partners we agree

[Verse 2]
Receiver stands tight to the line
Partner stacks behind in line
After return slide to position
Kitchen line in transition
Uno dos tres team flow
Mano firme nice and slow
Fake the stack to confuse
Then real stack on point two

[Bridge]
Not every point needs the stack
Read their pattern then react
Strong sides cover middle ground
Weak sides hidden out of sound

[Chorus]
Stacking strategy stacking strategy
Forehands center forehands free
Stacking strategy stacking strategy
Vamos partners we agree

[Outro]
Strong side middle
Stack and slide
Strong side middle
Stack and ride
